purpose: Measure portfolio discovery and meaningful intent without collecting unnecessary personal data.
status: Specification only; no analytics provider or tracking script is installed.

events.name: project_open
events.trigger: Visitor opens a project page or project detail

events.name: promptless_open
events.trigger: Visitor opens the Promptless project page

privacy_requirements: Do not collect contact form contents or Promptless task content in analytics.
Do not include names, email addresses, phone numbers, webhook URLs or generated outputs in event properties.
Select a provider only after reviewing consent requirements, data residency, retention and deletion controls.
If consent is required, do not load analytics before consent.
Prefer aggregate reporting and short retention periods.
